resources.string: This guest\'s software keymaster signs attestation chains with a chain built into its system library. Replace it with your own: fill in the certificate content yourself — nothing is pre-filled — then generate or import a chain and implant it into this guest\'s library. The original library is backed up first and can be restored at any time. Changes apply at the guest\'s next boot.
Leave a field empty to leave it out of the certificate. The attestation certificate carries the same name; the two are told apart by serial number and purpose, not by wording.
Fill in at least one certificate field first.
Enter a validity between 1 and 50 years.
No chain material yet — generate one above or import a bundle.
Library: implanted, but not with the chain currently held.
Library: differs from both the backup and the held chain.

A PEM bundle or PKCS#12 holding, for both RSA and EC: the root certificate, the root private key, the attestation certificate and the attestation private key. The bundle is verified piece by piece on import; its certificates are then re-issued from its own keys and names at the library\'s fixed lengths, because a finished certificate cannot be resized without breaking its signature.
The exported bundle contains private keys. Keep it somewhere safe.
The six built-in slots of this guest\'s keymaster library are rewritten with this chain. The original library is backed up first. Applies at the guest\'s next boot.
The backed-up original library goes back byte for byte. The built-in chain applies again at the guest\'s next boot.
Implanted — applies at the next boot.
The library already carries this chain.
Original library restored — applies at the next boot.
the guest has no keymaster library at the expected place
there is no chain material yet
there is no backup of the original library
the guest\'s keymaster library does not have the expected built-in chain — nothing was changed
the filled-in content does not fit the library\'s fixed space (%1$s) — shorten a field
a generated piece did not land on the library\'s fixed size
that file is not a readable PEM bundle or PKCS#12
the bundle is encrypted — enter its password above (or the password is wrong)
the attestation certificate is not signed by the root (%1$s)
the attestation private key does not match its certificate (%1$s)
an unsupported key (%1$s): RSA keys must be 1024-bit, EC keys P-256, and the RSA attestation key must encode to exactly the slot size
the bundle has no private key for %1$s — without it the certificates cannot be re-issued at the fixed lengths
